SWAttributionView.doc: A view that displays the sender who shares a highlight and provides related actions.

SWCollaborationHighlight.doc: A highlight object that represents an active collaboration.

SWCollaborationView.doc: A view that contains the collaboration content and options.

SWHighlight.doc: An object that represents a universal link to share by any number of contacts in one or more conversations.

SWHighlightCenter.doc: An object that contains a priority-ordered list of universal links to share with the current user.

SWHighlightChangeEvent.doc: An object that represents change activity for a highlight.

SWHighlightMembershipEvent.doc: An object that represents membership activity for a highlight.

SWHighlightMentionEvent.doc: An object that represents mention activity for a highlight.

SWHighlightPersistenceEvent.doc: An object that represents persistence activity for a highlight.

SWRemoveParticipantAlert.doc: An alert that prompts the user to remove a participant from a Messages group.

SWCollaborationViewDelegate.doc: A delegate object that the system notifies about changes to the collaboration popover state.

SWHighlightCenterDelegate.doc: The protocol you use to notify the delegate when the list or rank order of surfaced highlights changes.

SWHighlightEvent.doc: A protocol that defines an activity that the system posts in response to a user action for a highlight.

SWAttributionViewBackgroundStyle.doc: The background styling of the attribution view’s contents.

SWAttributionViewDisplayContext.doc: The context for the content that influences the ranking of this view’s highlight.

SWAttributionViewHorizontalAlignment.doc: The horizontal alignment of attribution view’s contents.

SWHighlightCenterErrorCode.doc: The error codes for the highlight center.

SWHighlightChangeEventTrigger.doc: The type of change event for the highlight

SWHighlightMembershipEventTrigger.doc: The type of membership event for the highlight.

SWHighlightMembershipEventTriggerAddedCo.doc: Signifies the system added a collaborator.

SWHighlightMembershipEventTriggerRemoved.doc: Signifies the system removed a collaborator.

SWHighlightPersistenceEventTrigger.doc: Signifies the type of persistence event trigger.

-initWithItemProvider:.doc: Creates and initializes a collaboration view.

-setShowManageButton:.doc: A Boolean value the system uses to show or hide the default manage-participants button in the collaboration popover.

-clearNoticesForHighlight:.doc: Clears the notices for a specified collaboration highlight.

-collaborationHighlightForIdentifier:err.doc: Returns a collaboration highlight for a specified collaboration identifier.

-getCollaborationHighlightForURL:complet.doc: Returns a collaboration highlight for a specified URL.

-getHighlightForURL:completionHandler:.doc: Returns a highlight for a specified URL.

-getSignedIdentityProofForCollaborationH.doc: Signs passed-in data with the local device’s private key.

-postNoticeForHighlightEvent:.doc: Posts a specified event to the highlight center for display.

backgroundStyle.doc: The background style of the child view that contains names and avatars.

menuTitleForHideAction.doc: A localized string the system uses as a custom title for the hide menu item.

supplementalMenu.doc: A supplemental menu to augment the attribution view’s existing menu.

collaborationIdentifier.doc: A unique identifier that the app hosting the collaboration provides.

contentType.doc: The UTI type for this collaboration highlight.

creationDate.doc: The date the system creates this file.

title.doc: The title of the collaboration highlight.

activeParticipantCount.doc: The number of participants in a collaboration.

cloudSharingServiceDelegate.doc: A reference to an object that conforms to the cloud-sharing service delegate protocol.

delegate.doc: The delegate object for the collaboration view.

headerImage.doc: The image that the system displays in the header.

headerSubtitle.doc: The subtitle that the system displays in the header.

headerTitle.doc: The title that the system displays in the header.

manageButtonTitle.doc: The manage button title that the system displays in the header.

identifier.doc: The unique identifier for the highlight.

delegate.doc: The delegate object for the highlight center.

highlightCollectionTitle.doc: A localized title to display with a collection of highlights.
